description: Python SDK (the eventregistry package) for the Event Registry / NewsAPI.ai API: search news articles and events by keywords, concepts, categories, sources, locations, dates and sentiment, compute aggregates and trends, follow feeds of new content and use the text analytics services.
rules: Install with `pip install eventregistry`, import with `from eventregistry import *` and create one `EventRegistry(apiKey = ...)` instance that is reused for all requests. If no key is passed, it is read from the EVENTREGISTRY_API_KEY environment variable.

To retrieve more than one page of results use the iterator classes (QueryArticlesIter, QueryEventsIter, QueryEventArticlesIter) with `q.execQuery(er, maxItems = N)` instead of paging manually. Always set maxItems, since every downloaded page of results uses tokens.

Filter by concepts, categories, sources, locations and authors using their URIs, not their names. Get the URI first with er.getConceptUri(), er.getCategoryUri(), er.getSourceUri(), er.getLocationUri() or er.getAuthorUri() - they return None when nothing matches.
Use concepts (conceptUri) to find content about an entity or a topic regardless of the language and the wording of the article; use keywords for exact words and phrases.

To pass several values to a parameter wrap them in QueryItems.AND([...]) or QueryItems.OR([...]) so that the operator is explicit. For nested boolean conditions use ComplexArticleQuery / ComplexEventQuery with BaseQuery and CombinedQuery, and initWithComplexQuery().

Choose the returned properties with ReturnInfo and the ArticleInfoFlags, EventInfoFlags, SourceInfoFlags, ConceptInfoFlags, ... classes. Request only what is needed (for example bodyLen = 0 when the article body is not used).

A query with QueryArticles or QueryEvents needs a requested result (RequestArticlesInfo, RequestArticlesTimeAggr, RequestEventsInfo, ...); er.execQuery(q) returns a dict in which the results are stored under the name of the result type, e.g. res["articles"]["results"].
Dates are in UTC and are passed as "YYYY-MM-DD" strings or datetime.date / datetime.datetime objects.

Requests fail with subclasses of EventRegistryError: UnauthorizedError (invalid key or no tokens left), ForbiddenError, InvalidRequestError, ServerError, NetworkError. Temporary errors are already retried by the SDK with a backoff (requests rejected because of too many simultaneous requests until they succeed), so do not wrap the calls in an own retry loop.
Queries that search the archive (content older than 31 days) use more tokens. Create EventRegistry(allowUseOfArchive = False) when only recent content is needed.

Do not sort by socialScore or facebookShares - the data about the shares on social media is no longer collected and the server ignores these sort options. Sort by date, rel, sourceImportance (articles) or date, rel, size (events).
Make the requests sequentially. The number of requests that can be executed at the same time is limited and the extra ones are rejected.
